# Human character assets

- Original artist/library: Microsoft Rocketbox, https://github.com/microsoft/Microsoft-Rocketbox
- Original characters: Male_Adult_04 and Female_Adult_07.
- Licence: MIT, Copyright (c) 2020 Microsoft. Full notice: LICENSE-Microsoft.txt.
- Web conversion source: https://github.com/927tanmay/react-ai-voice-avatar/tree/main/assets/avatars
- Conversion script: https://github.com/927tanmay/react-ai-voice-avatar/blob/main/scripts/convert-rocketbox.py
- Local names: aarav.glb → male.glb; ananya.glb → female.glb.
- Downloaded 2026-10-20. Binary files are redistributed with the original Microsoft notice.
- Geometry, skeletal weights, clothing/skin textures, 52 ARKit expressions and 15 visemes are embedded. No remote avatar API or runtime external fetch is used.
- The game drives continuous joint rotations and subtle facial morphs; mouth motion is procedural speech motion, not phoneme-aligned lip synchronization.
